goal: Shrink the txospenderindex database size on disk and lower indexing time.
Lay the groundwork for running txospenderindex on pruned nodes by referencing blocks instead of raw files.
reviewability: CI is failing, so verify whether the failure is caused by this PR before doing a deep review.
agreement: Concept approval citing tests that shrank the database from ~84GB to ~62GB with faster indexing (andrewtoth)
Withdrew a suggestion to bundle pruning support now, agreeing to wait for #36002 first (andrewtoth)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because key entries shrink by roughly 33%, reducing index disk usage from ~84GB to ~62GB in tests.
Indexing times are substantially lower for nodes running txospenderindex.
Decoupling entries from raw disk file positions helps unblock future pruning support.
